title: The things we never see
subject: Harold Edgerton's high-speed photography
context: A drop of milk hits a surface. For an instant, it becomes a crown. Electrical engineer Harold Edgerton used remarkably brief flashes of light to reveal moments ordinarily hidden from human perception.

destination.label: MIT Museum: Doc's life (Harold "Doc" Edgerton collection)
